description: This file defines a REST API controller 'VersionAPI' for the OrangeHRM system, providing an endpoint to retrieve version migration information, specifically handling version retrieval and exclusion of the latest version.

classes.name: VersionAPI
classes.description: Controller class responsible for providing version information via a REST API endpoint, extending a base installer REST controller.

methods.name: handleGet
methods.description: Handles HTTP GET requests, retrieves available version migration keys, optionally excluding the latest version based on a query parameter.
